svg.title: Language models, activations and linear probes
svg.desc: Profile-conditioned synthetic text supplies training material for a linear readout of a frozen language model. Human writing is evaluated through the same representation and fixed readout against independent psychological measurements. The layer stack, activation values and profile bars are schematic; they provide a schematic representation of the analysis.
